summary: The dispute arose over a mining lease granted to Vinay Kumar Singh for sand excavation in an area partially overlapping with Madhya Pradesh. The High Court ordered refund of royalty deposits after finding the state failed to deliver possession due to unresolved boundary dispute. The review order partially allowed state's plea by permitting deduction for 22,820 cubic meters of mined material. The Supreme Court examined whether the state failed to hand over possession and whether refund of deposit was justified.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 226 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: The appeal was disposed of with directions that the State of U.P. refund the amount deposited by the respondent after deducting the value of 22,820 cubic meters of mined sand/morum, along with interest at 6% per annum from the date of deposit until refund, in compliance with the modified order of the Allahabad High Court.
